text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Narita Taishin seemed to be under the weather,
so I brought her to the infirmary.
choice_data_list: You get some proper rest, you hear?
Take your time and get some rest, okay?

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Yeah, yeah... Jeez. You worry way too much.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
...I'm gonna sleep.
You should get back to work.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: ...Huh? What is this place...
Taishin! Taaishiiin!!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
Nnh...? Is that Ticket's voice?
Though she's usually way louder than that...

text_block_list.name: Minining Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Taishin, Taishin, Taaishiiin!
I'm over heeeere!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
...Wait, Ticket!? You're tiiiiny!
What the heck, you look like a grain of rice!!

text_block_list.name: Chibiwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Hey, Taishin. Watch your step, please.
It would be quite troublesome if you got trampled underfoot.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, Hayahide too!?
Aw, c'mon...

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
...Hk, hahahahaha!!
Look at you guys, acting all cute.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
So this is what looking down on Hayahide
and Ticket feels like. Hmmm...

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
...Want me to carry you in my pocket or something?
It's dangerous being so tiny.

text_block_list.name: Minining Ticket
text_block_list.text: Yay! Taishin, thank you sooo much!!

text_block_list.name: Chibiwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Thank you.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Nope, it's nothing at all. ...Hahaha!!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: ...What was that dream just now?

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Ah... My body feels light.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Narita Taishin seems to have gotten her groove back!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Whoa!? My body is...?!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, whoa, whoa...!
It's—it's getting bigger and bigger...!?

text_block_list.name: Minining Ticket
text_block_list.text: Aah?! Taishin, Taishi— ...!! ......!!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
What?! I can't hear you...!
Did I get too massive...?!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Hey, seriously! This is just too much...!!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Whoa!!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: ...The absolute worst. I had a weird dream...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It seems Narita Taishin wasn't able to
get back into top shape...
